sum: OKYO Pharma Limited, a clinical-stage ophthalmology company, develops therapies for corneal and anterior diseases in the United Kingdom. Its lead clinical product candidate is urcosimod, which is in Phase 2 clinical trials for the treatment of dry eye disease and neuropathic corneal pain. The company is also developing OK-201 for the treatment of acute and chronic ocular pain. OKYO Pharma Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
ceo: Mr. Robert J. Dempsey M.B.A. (CEO & Executive Director)
